scope: Theorem 1.2 (Acceptance-probability approximation) of the manuscript “Exact derandomization of logarithmic space: L = RL = BPL” (preprints/Exact-Derandomization-of-Logarithmic-Space-L-equals-RL-equals-BPL-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 103 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 15030fab23d31a4d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a randomized machine M with polyno- mial worst-case running time and O(log(n + 2)) work space. Let pM(x) be its acceptance probability on an input x of length n. There is a uniform deterministic algorithm which, on input (x, 1q) with q ≥ 1, outputs an integer 0 ≤ a ≤ 2q+2 satisfying a2−(q+2) − pM(x) ≤ 2−q . It uses O(log(n + 2) + q) work space and (n + 2)O(1)2O(q) time. The constants depend only on M.
